root_cause: The exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox incorrectly includes both `data-checkbox-exclusive` and `data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms"` attributes. The NHSUK checkboxes widget expects exclusive checkboxes to have only `data-checkbox-exclusive` (as seen in the working contact group), while non-exclusive checkboxes carry the group attribute. This conflict prevents the widget from clearing other checkboxes when the exclusive option is selected via keyboard.
repair_strategy: Remove the `data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms"` attribute from the exclusive checkbox, aligning it with the pattern used in the contact group where the exclusive option has only `data-checkbox-exclusive`.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive>

expected_accessibility_effect: Restores keyboard-accessible mutually exclusive behavior for the symptom group, ensuring that selecting 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard and 4.1.2 name/role/value requirements.
functional_risks: Minimal; the change only affects the exclusive checkbox's attribute configuration.
The contact group regression guard should continue to pass as it uses the same pattern.
verification_requirements: After the edit, journey step 5 must pass: focusing #symptoms-none and pressing Space results in form-data symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being empty.
Regression guard for the contact group must continue to pass.
